verdict.rationale: First-party Agent API docs state that structured output makes the model return JSON conforming to a schema you define, ready to deserialize directly. Sonar endpoint requests are being reformulated as Agent API requests, so the capability is part of the same API surface. The evidence is a single clear doc statement with little depth. Missing for 10: details on supported JSON Schema features and limits, Sonar-endpoint-specific schema parameters, and independent or hands-on corroboration of schema adherence.
